title: Hadith on Supporting Orphans
summary: The Prophet (PBUH) emphasized the high reward for caring for orphans in Paradise, showing closeness with specific gestures.
translation: In the society we live in, it is our responsibility to take care of the poor, orphans, and helpless people. If every person recognizes and fulfills this responsibility with efforts, then no community, no class, no village, no building, or no neighborhood would have individuals who need to ask others to fulfill their needs. That is why the Messenger of Allah, the Holy Prophet (PBUH), gave great glad tidings for supporting the helpless and caring for orphans. There is a hadith of Hazrat Sahl bin Sa'ad (RA) in which the Messenger of Allah, the Holy Prophet (PBUH), said, 'I and the person who takes care of an orphan will be in Paradise like this.' And he (PBUH) showed the closeness by joining his index and middle fingers, then said that the one who cares for an orphan will be this close to me. This indicates the closeness between me and the one who supports the orphan in Paradise. Some scholars mention that the slight distance shown between the fingers indicates that the rank of prophethood is near to the generous one, and a generous person is very beloved to Allah. Thus, it is understood that caring for orphans and organizing their support is a great act and efforts should be made to implement it.
